description: ALBANY, NY — I was informed yesterday that Crystal Run Healthcare/Optum is closing it’s OB/GYN practice in Rock Hill as of July 1st of this year.  This is a devastating loss for women’s health in Sullivan County.

title: Assembly Member Kay’s Statement on the Sudden Closure of OB/GYN unit at Crystal Run – Rock Hill | Paula for Assembly
